main_body: Farm ground patch, 4x3 tiles: a golden wheat band on top, a green crop row below it, then tilled brown soil rows with sprouts, all seen from above
top_band: none. This is flat ground terrain, not a standing object, so there is no top band and front face to read. A column through the middle runs wheat (rows 0-14), green crops (16-28), then soil rows with sprouts (30-46).
evidence: The kind is terrain (ground), so the standing-object 3/4 contract does not apply. It is a flat ground patch of crop and soil rows with no standing volume, no isometric side faces, and no hat-on-elevation construction. Terrain is accepted as ground.

style.evidence: The wheat uses about 5 yellow and ochre steps with pale highlight flecks. The crops use about 4 greens with lighter tufts. The soil has about 5 browns with lighter clods and grain. The dark edges are dark brown or dark green, tinted to the neighbouring material, not neutral black. There are no large flat fills, and each tile carries many colours, about as rich as or richer than the plain grass reference. The pattern repeats very regularly, but the shading and texture hold up next to the reference.
